title: Madrid Rooftops Obby · a 3D obby made with Neblla
meta_desc: Hop from rooftop to rooftop with your Neblla doll: moving platforms, spikes, a saw, a trampoline and lava below. The whole course is one JSON file read by Mundo, Neblla's 3D engine.
intro: Cross the rooftops to the flag: platforms that come and go, spikes, a trampoline, a saw that cuts the bridge and two tiles that appear and disappear. There is lava below: if you fall, you go back to the last checkpoint.
keys: Move with <kbd>WASD</kbd> or the arrow keys, run with <kbd>Shift</kbd> and jump with <kbd>space</kbd>. On a phone, use the joystick and the jump button.
medals_info: Medals: gold in {gold}, silver in {silver} and bronze in {bronze}.
doll_hint: You are playing with the default doll. Make your own in Neblla Creator and it will show up here.
lose_text: Five minutes and the flag is still there. Again?
failed_world: This game needs the Mundo module turned on.
